cross_module_laws: A library's semantic role selects its lawful composition operators, resource contract, refusal surface and minimum oracle classes.
Compiler optimizations may use only explicit algebraic laws whose evidence covers the exact editions and semantic profile.
Every effectful composition aggregates finite budgets, cancellation, partiality, evidence and failure domains instead of erasing them.
Conformance is claim×subject-edition×profile×evidence×verdict; no global conformant flag exists.
Provider qualification requires contract conformance and operational acceptance; neither substitutes for the other.
Agents and learned components remain optional bounded providers behind the same deterministic contracts, refusals, budgets and evidence gates.

non_collapse_laws: a type signature is not a semantic contract
carrier type is not entity aggregate repository or DTO
predicate is not policy decision or authorization
pure transformation is not migration or external effect
planner/compiler output is intent not execution
port is not adapter provider or runtime
adapter is not semantic owner
repository is not aggregate or event ledger
oracle is not implementation
projection is not source of truth
instrumentation is not business behavior
default trait method is not a universal domain default
async syntax does not establish cancellation backpressure or thread safety
genericity is not domain generality
one role may import another but cannot silently absorb its authority
every public operation has total typed outcomes rather than hidden panics or string errors
syntactic nesting is not semantic composition
shared carrier is not closed composition
merge join union overlay override and reconciliation are distinct
associativity commutativity and idempotence are never assumed
identity zero bottom top empty missing and unknown remain distinct
fallback is not catch-all error suppression
parallel execution requires proved independence order and resource bounds
reordering requires an explicit law for the declared profile
fixed-point iteration requires order termination and widening/convergence conditions
monotonicity in one order does not imply monotonicity in another
CRDT convergence does not establish application invariant preservation
conflict-free does not mean conflict absent
lossy composition exposes residual information
policy combining is not boolean folding
adapter composition multiplies preservation obligations
optimization may use only ratified laws and must preserve refusals/effects/evidence

failure_coordinates: fault vs refusal vs resource exhaustion
provider vs adapter vs domain source
non_collapse_laws: capacity offer is not reservation allocation or observed availability
quota is not budget reservation precharge or usage
deadline timeout cancellation and termination are distinct
backpressure is not unbounded buffering or silent dropping
retry is a new attempt and consumes budget
transient labels do not prove retry safety
failure exception refusal rejection and defect remain distinct
provider error is translated at the ACL and does not become a domain error by string mapping
partial failure and unknown completion are total outcomes
cancellation request does not prove work stopped
compensation is not rollback and can fail
degraded mode requires separate authority and acceptance
availability is scoped by time topology and failure assumptions
observed latency is not an SLO guarantee
resource reclamation needs evidence where leaks matter
overload policies preserve fairness authority and safety constraints
claim is not evidence and evidence is not acceptance
provenance is not truth or integrity
integrity is not correctness
test pass is scoped to edition profile inputs environment and oracle
examples do not establish universal laws
property-based testing is not exhaustive proof
shrinking a counterexample does not identify root cause
model checking proves the model within explored bounds not its implementation
formal proof is relative to assumptions specification and refinement
telemetry absence is not absence of failure
coverage percentage is not behavioral completeness
a TCK proves only encoded conformance requirements
self-attestation is not independent appraisal
two implementations can share the same specification error
AI or agents may generate hypotheses/tests but cannot be evidence authority or accept residual risk
evidence expires when relied-upon meaning code dependency provider configuration or environment changes
negative/adversarial twins are required for dangerous boundary claims
every verdict preserves unresolved defeaters and the residual owner

negative_mission: Do not infer laws from type signatures, composability from plug compatibility, reliability from retries, success from absence of exceptions, conformance from examples, truth from provenance, or proof from telemetry or AI-generated tests.
ratification_gate: Named semantic, algebra, runtime/resource, assurance and every affected family owner accept roles, laws, budgets, total failures, oracle sufficiency and evidence expiry; implementations remain unqualified until profile-specific conformance and acceptance pass.
sovereign_question: What exact role and law does each library own, how may it compose, under which finite resources and total failure semantics, and what edition-bound evidence is sufficient to trust an implementation for a declared profile?
